text:
priya_sen: quick pulse check — i pushed the latest company-level OKR draft into the doc, highlighted 3 changes since the last pass. requesting endorsement by EOD Wed so we can lock comms and updates to the handbook. link: https://rwd.in/okrs/q3-draft  

jamie_kim: thanks priya. skimmed — the tradeoff note on Dedicated capacity vs. Hosted growth looks reasonable but needs a clear guardrail if costs exceed forecast. can we add a rollback threshold?

priya_sen: yup added a rollback threshold line: if monthly unit cost delta > 12% for two consecutive weeks, trigger canary reduction and pause billing experiments.

alex_ng: small engineering ask — the P95 latency KR for hosted gen  <200ms assuming batching optimizations. we need to allow a 6-week runway for engine/kernel upgrades. flagged in the doc.

rachel_zhou: for Model Quality KR around eval pass rate, i put baseline + target for top 10 customer prompts. want to ensure we include a failure budget tied to regressions, not just absolute numbers.

priya_sen: good call rachel — added a 1% regression budget on any rolling 30d window, auto-alert to product and research if breached.

cecilia_wong: infra note — Private deployments KR depends on KMS rollout in regions EU-W and US-C. we have two sprints to get certing in each region, otherwise we hit the milestone risk. added a dependency table.

sam_torres: design note — marketing-facing theme needs 2 hero use cases for the launch page (integrations + cost savings). will have assets by next Thu.

deploy-bot: deploy notice — okrs/2026-q3-draft.md updated by priya_sen at 2026-03-10T10:02:15Z

jamie_kim: my open question — do we signoff on the new Dedicated revenue KR that shifts weight from MRR to booked commits? want to avoid perverse incentives for sales to push overprovisioning.

martin_lewis: agree with jamie. propose we tie Dedicated KR to utilization target >= 70% over quarter and customer satisfaction >= 4.2. that balances revenue and efficiency.

priya_sen: added utilization + CSAT tie. also added a cadence: weekly utilization report to finance and ops.

alex_ng: regarding the canary plan: we should specify automatic fallback to a lighter quantized model variant if p99 errors spike. included snippet in the rollout appendix: ```if p99_errors > 0.5% for 10m then route 30% traffic to backup model and trigger oncall```.

rachel_zhou: one more for evals — add a specific prompt set for legal/reg compliance customers to ensure no hallucinated answers in regulated flows.

priya_sen: done, labeled it KR 2.3 compliance prompt set.

cecilia_wong: risk matrix updated. top risk is region cert delay -> mitigation is provisional gating: ship Hosted & Dedicated in available regions, Private gated to certified regions only.

sam_torres: quick UX nit — onboarding flow language should say "pin model version" not "pin model". small but impacts docs.

jamie_kim: can we get a vote? thumbs up if you endorse the draft as-is with the changes noted. 2 votes required from execs (jamie, martin) plus signoff from eng lead.

alex_ng: +1 from eng side, assuming the 6-week runway and fallback snippets hold. :+1:

rachel_zhou: +1 for research.

cecilia_wong: +1 from infra.

sam_torres: +1 design.

martin_lewis: endorsing. couple of asks for comms: include a short blurb about cost controls and reliability guarantees for the newsletter.

priya_sen: awesome — final checklist i used to prepare the doc: 
- update KR baselines and targets (done)
- add rollback thresholds for cost experiments (done)
- add infra region dependencies (done)
- include canary/fallback snippet in rollout appendix (done)
- compliance prompt set added (done)
- design assets timeline (sam)

priya_sen: next steps: jamie to confirm exec signoff in this thread, cecilia and alex to finalize runbooks, sam to hand assets to marketing, i'll schedule the comms draft for Thu.

jamie_kim: confirmed. endorsing and will prep the exec note for tomorrow.

martin_lewis: thanks team. consider this the formal endorsement. Priya — lock the doc and circulate the comms draft once ready. :tada: 

priya_sen: locking now. will post the comms draft here when complete. thanks all for the rapid turnaround. :heart:
